So a meta-comment about WHATNOT scheduling:  we switched to a 2 week cycle.  However, out of the next 3 AMER/EMEA (9am California time) meetings, 2 out of the 3 are on US holidays where I would really expect everyone in the US to be unavailable (and for the second one, many other countries too).  Two weeks from today is US Thanksgiving and 6 weeks from today is Christmas Eve.  So we're essentially on a 4-week WHATNOT cadence for North America until mid-January.

<div id="outer">
  <div id="inner"></div>
  <script>
    const mo = new MutationObserver(console.log);
    mo.observe(outer, { childList: true, subtree: true, delivery: "batch" });
    mo.observe(inner, { childList: true, delivery: "batch" });
    inner.append("x");
  </script>
  <!-- network pause -->
</div>

content.body: inner.append("x") creates one record for mo. - Under the rule for outer (still streaming, subtree: true), it is held until . - Under the rule for inner (already closed), it is delivered at the next microtask checkpoint.
